The download button in the header triggers the following flow: Calls onDownload callback Attempts fetch with mode: "cors" to get the file as a Blob Creates a temporary download link via URL.createObjectURL Falls back to direct <a download> if the fetch fails Disable the download button entirely with downloadable={false} .
